targets.claim: Deposit spend cannot consume withdrawal-reserved ETH.
Router-pulled wei equals 32 ETH times actual deposits and leaves no router residual.
Accepted module reports set router validator balance to the module-balance sum.
Reward distribution reads the latest accepted module-balance report.
Reward fees are bounded by configured basis points and aligned with module recipients.
Non-active or deposit-paused modules receive no deposits; stopped modules receive no module reward payment.
